resources.string: Create an account to keep track of your balances.
Decide how much you want to spend on what each month.
Add a transaction with the plus button. Give it a precise category and scan the receipt of a purchase: the more precise your transactions, the more the analysis and the saving tips can tell you.
Contracts are detected automatically from regular debits to the same payee.
MyExpenses can search your transactions for regular debits, so that you don\'t have to look for your contracts by hand. The analysis runs only on your device. You can remove wrong matches afterwards.
Contracts are not detected automatically. You can start the analysis of your transactions at any time.
Contracts are assigned to an area by the category of their transactions. You can change the area in the details of a contract.
Contracts in “%1$s” go back to their automatic area.

For saving tips, your transactions are searched for contracts and regular expenses. The analysis runs only on your device.

Hints show up here as soon as your transactions reveal something, for example when contracts become more expensive. The more precise your categories and the more receipts you scan, the more there is to tell.
Whether you buy more of them than usual shows once you scan receipts over a few months.
Whether you buy drugstore goods at the supermarket, where they are often more expensive, shows on scanned supermarket receipts.
Whether you pay more deposit than you get back shows on scanned receipts.
On which categories you spend more than usual can only be told when your expenses have a precise category. The tab \"%s\" shows which are missing.
